name: Bonhomme de Neige
original_name: ボノム・ デ ・ネージュ
source:
Aoi's partner, a Snow Fairy-type guardian.

It's ability is "Business Ability Increase". It increases all the necessary attributes her master needs in her work. Being able to control Ice and Snow, Bonomu is capable of creating Snowstorms to freeze her targets.
